question: The remaining east/west gap in the Earth supply calibration sits mostly in Greek cities whose Hanson areas are wall circuits (Tegea 190 ha, Argos 199, Mantinea 121). If only the inhabited part of a Greek wall circuit counts as the city's size, does the whole-empire calibration (floodplain production, Frier people level) pass?

source.citation: M. H. Hansen, 'An Update on the Shotgun Method', Greek, Roman, and Byzantine Studies 48 (2008) 259-286, restating The Shotgun Method (2006) 21-24, 47
source.copy: PDF supplied by the owner on 14 Nov 2026 (sha256 019e09ff83af5d7c0045bd1b90f96a21ad78e009466d287843c4771104607673); kept outside the repository
source.rule_read: pp. 265-272: 150 persons per ha of inhabited space; about half of the intramural area inhabited (Eretria 81.5 ha, Himera 82, Phleious 60, Tanagra 60, Iasos 26, Plataiai 10), 'only a third' for large circuits (Samos 103 ha, Sikyon 175, Tegea 190, Thebes 350; territory size 5 average 182 ha with a third). Exception: Mytilene 140 ha at half. Hansen stresses these are minima; army figures in texts often give about twice as many people.
source.era_caveat: Hansen's figures are Classical (5th-4th c. BC); the calibration is AD 150. Roman Greece had not grown into its old circuits (owner's map is not affected).

rule: For catalogue cities in provinces Achaea, Macedonia and Epirus whose Hanson 'Estimate Basis' starts with 'Walls': inhabited area = walled area x 1/2, or x 1/3 when the walled area is >= 100 ha (threshold between Himera 82 = half and Samos 103 = third; Mytilene is the stated exception). Residents = the sliding density applied to the inhabited area (the city's real built-up size). All other cities unchanged.

variants.greece_and_asia_minor: also provinces Asia and Lycia et Pamphylia (Greek poleis of Asia Minor in Hansen's sample: Chios, Samos, Iasos, Mytilene)
variants.greece_hansen_150: primary scope, but residents = 150 x inhabited area (Hansen's literal minimum)
variants.control: no change; must reproduce output/supply_people_level_20261114 'frier' surface exactly

setting: Whole empire, floodplain rule in production, heartland people at the Frier 61.4 M level (scripts/supply_people_level.py machinery).
rules: Original declared supply decision unchanged (270 km kept within ln 1.25 or 1.1 x best; transfer >= 0.90 both ways). Report e95 against the adopted 0.3923.
interpretation_declared: PASS on 'greece' = the Earth supply calibration passes with Egypt included, in development (the floodplain rule and this correction were both designed after seeing earlier failures). Sizes on the fantasy map are NOT changed (owner: sizes stay as they are); any size-model consequence would be a separate owner decision.
